views.markdown: An iOS developer framework for unified hooking methods.

Fix the batch deferred-original crash that broke v1-era consumers (e.g. Shadow 3.7.6) against HookKit v2.

**The bug:** HookKit v2's batched installs wrote originals into the caller's %orig cells only after the *entire* batch drain returned. A replacement installed earlier in the same batch was live while its %orig cell was still NULL — so any mid-batch re-entry into it (ElleKit's patch writer calls vm_region_recurse_64, which Shadow's Hook_Memory group hooks) called NULL and crashed (SIGSEGV at PC 0, reproduced on-device in 4/4 apps at launch). v1 never hit this: caller cells were the libhooker out-pointers, so each original published the moment its hook applied.

**The fix:** publish originals at apply time (v1 semantics) — batched function hooks use the caller's cell as the out-pointer (batch-owned cell as fallback), message-hook originals are written immediately, and origValue is synced afterward so the drain's non-NULL invariant and inline-guard settlement still see the real original. On-device verified: Shadow 3.7.6 launches the previously crashing apps cleanly.

Also in this tag (2.2.4-1 + 2.2.5-1 since 2.2.3-1):
- ElleKit ABI detection reverted to the tested filename discriminator (LHStrError is exported by both ElleKit and real libhooker, so symbol cross-checks fail closed against legitimate ElleKit installs)
- litehook: global-rebind list index fix (underflow on first insert, overwrite on later inserts)
- Availability introspection restores the compile-time backends (fishhook/litehook/native/dobby/swift) to getAvailableSubstitutorTypes/getAvailableCategories

Packages: iphoneos-arm (rooted), iphoneos-arm64 (rootless), iphoneos-arm64e (roothide).
